purpose: Test a justified CLI infrastructure correction after D095 failed; do not reinterpret or replace D095.
authentication: existing ChatGPT login; reject API-key or uncertain classification
prelaunch_requirements: Commit this plan, supervisor and tests before the real attempt.
Verify the six common source files and four prototype files against the original D-094 staging pins and frozen Git objects.
Prepare a new private directory; pin the prompt, schema, plan and copied sources.
Pass existing authentication paths without copying credentials and remove API-key environment variables.

Verify packaged local host executable and bounded --help without a model call before freezing; repeat preflight inside the shared deadline.

checkpoint_acceptance: A complete final local CLI turn with coherent non-null usage and no observed tool item.
A strict JSON proposal with all four phases, all nodes pending, a pending normative decision and a dependent engineering requirement.
Actual prototype init succeeds within the same remaining deadline.
Durable checkpoint and artifact hashes can be inspected by status in a fresh process.
failure_policy: Preserve partial streams, failures and missing outputs.
Never execute an already-started attempt again or repair its model proposal.
No fallback model, paid API call, permission bypass or replacement attempt in this protocol.
required_local_negative_checks: Real subprocess timeout retains partial output and rejects relaunch.
Changed source bytes are rejected before creating the destination.
Invalid dependencies, cycles, normative linkage and observed tool use cannot create an accepted checkpoint.
Mutation of checkpoint artifacts is rejected by fresh status.
